notes.title: WordSearch DLC Multiplayer Server is Down
notes.notes:
[p]The multiplayer feature of the WordSearch DLC is currently not working due to the server being down. This issue started yesterday.[/p][p][/p][p]This is the same reason as why the Gray Swan Games website is down:
[url="https://grayswangames.com"]https://grayswangames.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I have an open ticket with my server host. They tell me the data center is having technical problems and they don't know when it'll be back online. This is very frustrating and unprofessional. I hope it'll be back online very soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Singleplayer mode should work as usual.[/p]

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
[h2][u][b]New Mini-Game "Balldrop"[/b][/u][/h2]

I've added a free new mini-game called "Balldrop". The objective is to keep the ball on the board for as long as possible. There's a leaderboard containing everyone's best time.

[h3][u][b]Bug Fix[/b][/u][/h3]

I've fixed a bug with saving leaderboard times for PoolFrenzy.
